info.name: Kaiko Kart API
info.description:
Kaiko Kart Next.js API.

1. Select the **Kaiko Kart - Local** environment and set `email` / `password` for a Supabase Auth user.
2. Run **Auth > Login**. It stores `accessToken`, which every API request sends as a Bearer token.
3. Tokens expire after about 1 hour. Run **Auth > Refresh Token** or Login again.

request.description: Signs in with Supabase Auth (email + password) and saves the access and refresh tokens to the environment.

Creates an already-confirmed Supabase Auth user (no confirmation email) and signs in. full_name 2-120 chars, password 8-72 chars. Saves accessToken/refreshToken from the returned session. Existing email returns 409; validation errors return 422.
Always returns a generic 200 so accounts cannot be enumerated. Redirects to NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL/reset-password when set.
Requires a recovery session (the access token from the Supabase recovery link). Password 8-72 chars.
Signs out the current session. Run Auth > Login again afterwards.
Public. Returns API status.
Active categories ordered by display_order. Saves the first category's id as `categoryId`.

item.description: Two ways to order: Checkout - Pickup / Home Delivery send items directly to customer_checkout; Customer > Orders > Place Order from Cart checks out the cart for one store. Use Checkout Preview first to see the points total.

request.description: Prices the cart items for store_id in reward points. Returns items, total_points, available_points, points_shortfall and can_checkout. fulfilment_type: PICKUP | HOME_DELIVERY (address_id required for HOME_DELIVERY). Empty cart for the store returns 400; unavailable products return 409. Add items with Cart > Add Item to Cart first.

Returns id, balance, created_at, updated_at (balance 0 when no wallet exists yet).

request.description: Required: address_name, recipient_name (2-120), mobile (7-20 chars), address_line1 (3-200), city, state, pincode (5-10 digits). Optional: address_line2, landmark (nullable), is_default (default false). Validation errors return 422.
Partial update: send any of address_name, recipient_name, mobile, address_line1, address_line2, landmark, city, state, pincode, is_default (at least one). Unknown keys and an empty body return 422.

request.description: Checks out every cart item for store_id through customer_checkout, then clears that store's cart. fulfilment_type: PICKUP | HOME_DELIVERY (set address_id to {{addressId}} for HOME_DELIVERY). Empty cart returns 400; insufficient points, stock or address problems return 400 with a message.
Order with `items` (order_items) and `status_history`.
order_status, delivery_status, fulfilment_type and the status `history` timeline.
Calls cancel_order with p_items_physically_returned = false (never client-controlled).
Idempotent: adding a product already in the wishlist is ignored.
The path id is the product id, not a wishlist row id.
